question: What mental condition brings liberation to a person in this very life?
premises: One whose mind becomes unmanā attains a special state
Liberation is said to occur for such a person here
inference: Liberation arises here for one whose mind has become the transcendent unmanā state.
uncertainties: bhavantīha may be read as bhavati iha with sandhi fusion
plain_english: But for one whose mind has become the transcendent mind, liberation occurs here.
